paragraphs: I’m a junior sysadmin who learns fast and adapts quickly. In my internship I moved between server migrations, user support and Microsoft 365 administration, picking up each new tool as the work required it.

I like being the person teams can count on: helping users solve their day-to-day issues, taking initiative when something is stuck, and writing documentation so the next person doesn’t start from zero.
Right now I’m looking for my first role in systems administration or DevOps, where I can keep learning from a team and contribute from day one. Meanwhile, I’m studying Kubernetes towards the CKA.
